question.value: What is the magnetic field topology in the B335 Class 0 protostar envelope at 50-1000 au, and is it consistent with magnetically regulated collapse?

evidence.quote: the magnetic field is maintaining a high level of organization from scales 1000 au to 50 au: this suggests the field is dynamically relevant
This paper makes use of the ALMA data ADS/JAO.ALMA$\#2013.1.01380.S$.
Our ALMA Stokes I map of the 1.29 mm dust continuum emission in B335
The receiver was tuned to cover the 223-227 GHz and 239-243 GHz windows
using an aggregated bandwidth 7.5 GHz for the continuum emission (4 basebands of 1.87 GHz bandwidth each)
with 34 antennas sampling baselines from 21m to 639m (peak of baseline density around 200m)
The maps have a synthesized beam $0.8\hbox{$^{\prime\prime}$}\times 0.54\hbox{$^{\prime\prime}$}$ ($\sim 80\times54$au)

findings_qualitative.value: Ordered field: poloidal along outflow cavity walls, pinched/equatorial in the inner envelope

evidence.quote: a transition from a large-scale poloidal magnetic field, in the outflow direction, to strongly pinched in the equatorial direction

claims.hypothesis: Is dust polarization detected with a coherent field at 50-1000 au in B335?
claims.result: Polarization detected at all scales with fractional polarization ~4-11%
claims.finding: Field is highly ordered with pinched equatorial and poloidal cavity-wall components

evidence.quote: Linearly polarized dust emission arising from the circumstellar material in the envelope of B335 is detected at all scales probed by our observations

claims.hypothesis: Does the field strength imply a dynamically relevant field?
claims.finding: Field strongly amplified relative to larger scales, though DCF validity uncertain

evidence.quote: we find a magnetic field strength 300-3000 $\mu$G, at radii 50-500 au

claims.hypothesis: Is the topology consistent with magnetically regulated collapse?
claims.experiment: Morphological comparison with non-ideal MHD models
claims.result: Model with mu=6, beta=1e-3 resembles observed map; mu<5 too strong
claims.finding: Only magnetically regulated collapse with mu>5 explains the observations

evidence.quote: the pronounced pinching needed to explain the transition from an axial to an equatorial component as is observed in the B335 mid-plane is more easily obtained using MHD models with initial core mass-to-flux ratio $\mu > 5$

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Self-scattering as origin of polarization rejected since densities are too low and fractions too high

evidence.quote: are much higher than the gas densities probed at these scales in B335

limitations_admitted.value: Model comparison is only qualitative; DCF validity uncertain; interferometric filtering of large scales

evidence.quote: we stress that a perfect agreement is not sought for here
